front.title: Learnlog Assistance Capture Profile and Optional Event File Representation

abstract.t:
This document proposes Learnlog as an assistance capture profile for measuring AI scaffolding, with xAPI and Caliper bindings. Its motivation is Quantum Learning Machines' work on QLM Measure. The profile defines what assistance was requested, generated, transmitted, displayed, or accepted; what an instrument captured; and which facts remain unknown. Existing logging ecosystems can carry these definitions. Their reviewed base specifications do not, by themselves, require this particular combined agreement on assistance, achieved capture, unavailable information, and mapping provenance. Existing AI and tutoring profiles already cover important parts of the domain.
The document retains the existing Learnlog event file representation, hash chains, optional signed heads, and verifiable redaction as an optional carrier. An implementation can use the assistance profile without producing that file representation. Experimental companion software constructs importer-observation records in xAPI and Caliper while preserving source assistance assertions separately. The implementation does not establish independent interoperability, truthful or complete capture, independent learning, or scientific equivalence across products. The core file format is unchanged in this revision.
